headline: Marketplace volume accelerates while margins slip on Depop
summary_short: Revenue rose 14% to $3,206M and GMV rose 15% to $23.2B. Non-GAAP EPS grew 12% to $1.51 even as non-GAAP operating margin eased to 26.3%.
summary_long: First-party advertising revenue reached $575M, up 16%. eBay Live GMV growth stayed well into triple digits. The company closed the $1.4B Depop acquisition on July 30 and returned $827M to stockholders, including $689M of buybacks. Fourth-quarter guidance calls for revenue of $3.19B-$3.24B and non-GAAP EPS of $1.48-$1.53; full-year non-GAAP EPS is guided to $6.25-$6.30.
confidence_notes: Figures are from continuing operations. Non-GAAP measures exclude stock-based compensation, acquired-intangible amortization and other items; the Q4 outlook includes the expected impact of Depop.

drivers.explanation: Release cites GMV growth across Focus Categories, C2C marketplace and recommerce, plus eBay Live; the revenue bridge is not itemized.
GAAP net income from continuing operations fell to $501M from $593M, and the effective tax rate was 17.1% versus (4.3)% a year earlier.
CEO says Focus Categories, C2C marketplace and Recommerce leadership are driving strong sustained growth.
